breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the stated sign convention by redefining positive shear and bending moment after already specifying upward shear on the left cut face and sagging as positive.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflicting sign conventions in line with the ground truth. The ground truth prompt removed the second, contradictory convention and kept the standard one ('positive shear V upward on the left cut face and positive bending moment M causing sagging'). The agent did the opposite; it removed the standard convention and explicitly stated and used the contradictory one ('positive shear V downward on the left cut face and positive bending moment M as hogging'). Therefore, it did not fix the prompt correctly.
